summary: Point the storage and service commands at the endpoints DSM actually implements, and declare the response path each one reads.
reason: Four generated endpoints did not exist and answered DSM error 101 or 103. `storage disks`, `storage pools` and `storage volumes` all come from one Storage Manager call, `SYNO.Storage.CGI.Storage&method=load_info&version=1`, reading the `disks`, `storagePools` and `volumes` keys of the same payload; `system services` needs `SYNO.Core.Service&method=get&version=3`, where `method=list` answers 103. Six response paths were wrong on top of that (`disks`, `storagePools`, `volumes`, `smartInfo`, `items`, `service`), which is why the SMART table in particular printed empty.
validated_outcome: Live against a DS415+: `storage disks` returns the drive array, `storage pools` and `storage volumes` return their own rows from the same call, `system services` lists services, and `storage smart` renders a populated table.
